mentions.name: claude-image-renamer
mentions.description: This tool uses the Claude Code CLI to analyze screenshots and rename them to descriptive, usable filenames by combining OCR text extraction with Claude's vision capabilities. It handles macOS screenshot filenames with unusual Unicode characters, keeps names clean (lowercase, underscores, max 64 characters), resolves naming conflicts automatically, and can be set up as a macOS Folder Action so screenshots saved to a folder such as ~/Desktop are renamed automatically.
mentions.source_excerpt: claude-image-renamer uses Claude Code CLI to analyze screenshots and rename them to something actually usable. It combines OCR text extraction with Claude's vision capabilities, so instead of "Screenshot 2025-12-29 at 10.03.10 PM.png" you get something like "vscode_python_debug_settings.png".
